title: Image to mesh with core nodes

questions.q: What does resolution 3072 mean on EmptyLatentHunyuan3Dv2?
options: 3072 tokens of 64 numbers, a list with no grid in it
questions.answer: 3072 tokens of 64 numbers, a list with no grid in it
questions.why: The latent is [batch, 64, resolution]. The shape comes from decoding those tokens at points in space.

questions.q: Which part of this graph generates, and which only converts?
options: KSampler generates; the VAE decode and the mesh node convert
The mesh node generates the shape
questions.answer: KSampler generates; the VAE decode and the mesh node convert
questions.why: The sampler is where noise becomes tokens. Everything after is a fixed calculation from those tokens.

questions.q: Why do blocky meshes never reach the true area, however fine the grid?
options: Stairs keep the same total area when they get smaller: about 3/2 for a sphere
questions.answer: Stairs keep the same total area when they get smaller: about 3/2 for a sphere
questions.why: The lab prints about 1.5 at 16, 32 and 64. Only reading values between grid points fixes it.

questions.q: What does doubling octree_resolution do to decode cost?
options: About 8 times the queries, as it grows with the cube
questions.answer: About 8 times the queries, as it grows with the cube
questions.why: 257 cubed against 513 cubed is 16,974,593 against 135,005,697. num_chunks only batches them.

questions.q: The negative conditioning in this graph is what?
options: Zeros of the same shape as the image embedding
questions.answer: Zeros of the same shape as the image embedding

questions.q: Your mesh has very few triangles and parts missing. Which setting do you try first?
options: A lower threshold on the mesh node
Higher resolution on the VAE only
questions.answer: A lower threshold on the mesh node
questions.why: The threshold decides what counts as inside. In the lab, raising it from 0 to 0.6 falls from 4,620 to 108 triangles.
